items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tinny. [INTERVIEWEE] Ugh. I don’t dig it. I don’t like the feeling of it either.

ctx.x: I think it’s a weird sound, although you hear yourself better. You do hear yourself better, because it’s coming up at you, but it sounds like – it sounds so squeaky to me.
Ugh. I don’t dig it. I don’t like the feeling of it either. I mean, if you’re going to be like this, let’s go. Let’s go. This? Who needs that? But . . .
